adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, the blacklist is normalized to lowercase (`BLACKLISTED_GUEST_EMAILS.split(...).map(email => email.toLowerCase())`), but incoming `guest` values are compared verbatim via `!blacklistedGuestEmails.includes(guest)`, so case variants (e.g., `Evil@Example.com`) or whitespace-padded emails won’t match and can bypass the blacklist. Similarly, dedup against existing attendees is `guest === attendee.email` (case-sensitive), allowing case-variant duplicates to be created via `attendees.createMany`.
